title: Full-scale training and experiment infrastructure
status_justification: Config system + reproducible/resumable training + detector & combined evaluation pipelines + experiment tracking all exist; smoke validated; the full test suite passes; and ONE full GPU detector training+eval run completed (run_id phase6_detector_full_gpu).

detector_eval_full_gpu.verdict: BELOW CHANCE even at full scale. The v2 anomalies are relational (gender-flip, indication-removal, mutual-exclusion) and carry little next-token surprise, so an unsupervised next-token language model cannot separate them.

answers.interpretation: A full-scale detector is below chance; adding it to the score SIGNIFICANTLY HURTS vs ontology-only (paired ΔAUC -0.0845, CI excludes 0, p~0). The real ontology significantly beats the legacy baseline (+0.0892, p~0). The method is ontology-centered; the detector is a (currently non-additive) secondary signal.

committed: per-run train_metrics.jsonl / train_summary.json / detector_eval.* / combined_eval.* / config.json

claim_after_phase6: The project now has reproducible full-scale training + evaluation infrastructure for the Sgen-free ontology-calibrated system. NOT claimed: detector improves over ontology-only (it does not), combined is SOTA, or external validation.
next_step: Phase 7 (final evaluation + ablations). The honest headline for Phase 7: the ontology carries the discriminative signal (ontology_only_real ~0.79, CI clears chance, beats legacy); the unsupervised detector is below chance and non-additive; counterfactual repair is leakage-free; Sgen is excluded. H200 is NOT required (the bottleneck is the anomaly type, not compute).
